age_weight_normalization: training-bin count^(-0.5), then divide by training-weight mean
preprocessing_weights: none: selector and scaler use only unweighted training X
inner_selection: unweighted mean of three inner-fold global MAEs for every strategy
interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity after earlier outer OOF results were inspected; not untouched confirmatory or external validation.
comparison_rule: Report all strategies; do not choose a strategy or expand grids using outer test scores; keep original common_v1 as the uniform five-cell main analysis.
